description: Supplier call: one action with a deadline but no named owner, one with owner only, a decision and a vague wish.
transcript: Thanks for joining, this is about the enclosure order.
The supplier can deliver five hundred units in six weeks.
We decided to go with the grey plastic instead of aluminium.
The purchase order has to be signed before the 4th of December.
Tomas will check the drawings against the new board outline.
It would be nice to get a discount for the second batch.
